name.fr-FR: Projet de réunion des protestants à l’Église catholique
name.en-US: Plan for the Reunion of the Protestants with the Catholic Church
name.pt-BR: Projeto de reunião dos protestantes com a Igreja católica

description.fr-FR: Pièces et lettres des tentatives de réunion : avec les protestants de France (correspondance avec le ministre Ferry, 1660-1667) et d’Allemagne (Molanus, Leibniz, 1683-1701), le Projet de réunion, les Règles, les Réflexions sur l’écrit de Molanus et les cinquante-deux lettres échangées avec Leibniz. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Documents and letters of the attempts at reunion: with the Protestants of France (correspondence with the minister Ferry, 1660-67) and of Germany (Molanus and Leibniz, 1683-1701), the Plan of Reunion, the Rules, the Reflections on Molanus’s paper and the fifty-two letters exchanged with Leibniz. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Peças e cartas das tentativas de reunião: com os protestantes da França (correspondência com o ministro Ferry, 1660-1667) e da Alemanha (Molanus, Leibniz, 1683-1701), o Projeto de reunião, as Regras, as Reflexões sobre o escrito de Molanus e as cinquenta e duas cartas trocadas com Leibniz. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XVII, pages 008-011, and volume XVIII, pages 001-008. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
